blocks.en_text: Hello, I'm Neil.
blocks.zh_text: 你好，我是Neil。

blocks.en_text: And I'm Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Beth。

blocks.en_text: And you're listening to Real Easy  English, the podcast where we have
blocks.zh_text: 你正在收听的是Real Easy English，在这个播客里我们会进行

blocks.en_text: real conversations in easy  English to help you learn.
blocks.zh_text: 用简单英语进行的真实对话，帮助你学习。

blocks.en_text: To read along with this podcast,  you can find a text version on
blocks.zh_text: 想跟着这个播客一起读，你可以在

blocks.en_text: our website. Visit BBC Learning English dot com.
blocks.zh_text: 我们的网站上找到文字版。请访问BBC Learning English点com。

blocks.en_text: How are things, Beth?
blocks.zh_text: Beth，最近怎么样？

blocks.en_text: I'm very well, thank you, Neil. How are you?
blocks.zh_text: 我很好，谢谢你，Neil。你好吗？

blocks.en_text: Oh, I'm a little tired. I didn't sleep very well last night.
blocks.zh_text: 哦，我有点累。我昨晚没睡好。

blocks.en_text: And today's episode is all about sleep.
blocks.zh_text: 今天这一集全都跟睡眠有关。

blocks.en_text: We'll be talking about our sleep habits, and also our dreams.
blocks.zh_text: 我们会聊聊我们的睡眠习惯，还有我们的梦。

blocks.en_text: Lovely.
blocks.zh_text: 太好了。

blocks.en_text: So, Neil, you said that you didn't sleep well last night.
blocks.zh_text: 那么，Neil，你说你昨晚没睡好。

blocks.en_text: So that's not so lovely. Does that happen very often?
blocks.zh_text: 那可不太好啊。这种情况经常发生吗？

blocks.en_text: It happens all the time, Beth! I don't sleep very well.
blocks.zh_text: 一直都这样，Beth！我睡得不太好。

blocks.en_text: Oh, dear. How many hours do you sleep at night, Neil?
blocks.zh_text: 哎呀。Neil，你晚上睡几个小时？

blocks.en_text: I think probably six and a half hours.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得大概六个半小时吧。

blocks.en_text: — Really? — Mmm. How about you?
blocks.zh_text: ——真的吗？——嗯。你呢？

blocks.en_text: Well, if I sleep less than eight hours, then I'm exhausted.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，如果我睡不到八个小时，我就会累得不行。

blocks.en_text: I really like to sleep quite a lot!
blocks.zh_text: 我真的很喜欢睡很多觉！

blocks.en_text: Ah, you are exhausted. What does 'exhausted' mean, Beth?
blocks.zh_text: 啊，你累得不行。Beth，exhausted是什么意思？

blocks.en_text: — It means that you are 'really tired'. — Mm, yes.
blocks.zh_text: ——意思是“非常累”。——嗯，对。

blocks.en_text: Like you after last night because you didn't sleep very well. Are you exhausted?
blocks.zh_text: 就像你昨晚之后那样，因为你没睡好。你累得不行吗？

blocks.en_text: I am, Beth. I am absolutely exhausted.
blocks.zh_text: 是的，Beth。我真是累得不行。

blocks.en_text: What time do you usually go to bed, Neil?
blocks.zh_text: Neil，你通常几点上床睡觉？

blocks.en_text: About 11. I go to bed about 11.
blocks.zh_text: 大概11点。我大概11点上床。

blocks.en_text: I usually go earlier, but about ten o'clock.
blocks.zh_text: 我通常睡得早一些，大概十点吧。

blocks.en_text: And do you have dreams? Do you dream often?
blocks.zh_text: 那你做梦吗？你经常做梦吗？

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I do, but I find it quite hard to remember my dreams.
blocks.zh_text: 做，不过我发现自己很难记住做的梦。

blocks.en_text: But sometimes I have nightmares, and then they are easier to remember.
blocks.zh_text: 但有时候我会做噩梦，那些梦就比较容易记住。

blocks.en_text: So I might wake up in the middle of the night and feel a bit scared or worried.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我可能会半夜醒来，感觉有点害怕或者担心。

blocks.en_text: Can you tell us about a strange dream that you've had?
blocks.zh_text: 你能跟我们讲讲你做过的一个奇怪的梦吗？

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I had a weird dream a couple of nights ago.
blocks.zh_text: 可以，我前几天晚上做了一个奇怪的梦。

blocks.en_text: I was at my auntie's house in the kitchen
blocks.zh_text: 我在我阿姨家的厨房里

blocks.en_text: and then suddenly the floor was very wet
blocks.zh_text: 然后突然地板变得很湿

blocks.en_text: and there were three robbers that were going to come and open the front door.
blocks.zh_text: 还有三个劫匪要来打开前门。

blocks.en_text: So I had to run across the wet kitchen and lock the front door.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我不得不跑过湿漉漉的厨房去把前门锁上。

blocks.en_text: It was a bit scary and weird.
blocks.zh_text: 有点吓人，也挺奇怪的。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. That sounds like a really scary dream.
blocks.zh_text: 是啊。那听起来真是个很吓人的梦。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. So, a scary dream we can call a 'nightmare'.
blocks.zh_text: 对。所以，一个可怕的梦我们可以叫它“噩梦”。

blocks.en_text: So, I had a nightmare, a bad dream, the other night.
blocks.zh_text: 那么，前几天晚上我做了一个噩梦，一个不好的梦。

blocks.en_text: And I was in a foreign country, I think somewhere like Italy, a European place,
blocks.zh_text: 我在一个外国，好像是意大利那样的地方，一个欧洲的地方，

blocks.en_text: and I couldn't find my family.
blocks.zh_text: 然后我找不到我的家人了。

blocks.en_text: And I was running around the streets,
blocks.zh_text: 我在街上到处跑，

blocks.en_text: trying to find them and I couldn't find them.
blocks.zh_text: 想找到他们，可就是找不到。

blocks.en_text: But then, after a while of looking around the streets,
blocks.zh_text: 但后来，在街上找了一阵子之后，

blocks.en_text: I saw people in my family, and I felt much better.
blocks.zh_text: 我看到了我的家人，我感觉好多了。

blocks.en_text: So it sounds like it started as a nightmare,
blocks.zh_text: 所以听起来它一开始是个噩梦，

blocks.en_text: but then it kind of went into a dream.
blocks.zh_text: 但后来就有点像变成了一场梦。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. It was just a normal, happy dream by the end.
blocks.zh_text: 对。到最后它就只是一个普通、开心的梦了。

blocks.en_text: Good!
blocks.zh_text: 太好了！

blocks.en_text: Well, I noticed there that you used the past simple
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我注意到你刚才用了过去简单时

blocks.en_text: and the past continuous to describe your dream.
blocks.zh_text: 和过去进行时来描述你的梦。

blocks.en_text: You said 'I was running around', which is the past continuous
blocks.zh_text: 你说“I was running around”，这是过去进行时，

blocks.en_text: and then you said 'I found them', which was the past simple.
blocks.zh_text: 然后你说“I found them”，这是过去简单时。

blocks.en_text: And this is really common language that we use
blocks.zh_text: 这真的是我们描述过去的事情时

blocks.en_text: when we're describing things in the past like dreams.
blocks.zh_text: 很常用的语言，比如描述梦。

blocks.en_text: So, we've talked about how long we sleep for
blocks.zh_text: 那么，我们聊了我们睡多久

blocks.en_text: and we've talked about dreams and nightmares,
blocks.zh_text: 也聊了梦和噩梦，

blocks.en_text: but I have a big question for you, Neil.
blocks.zh_text: 但我有个大问题要问你，Neil。

blocks.en_text: Do you snore?
blocks.zh_text: 你打呼噜吗？

blocks.en_text: You do!
blocks.zh_text: 你打！

blocks.en_text: That is snoring. Do I snore?
blocks.zh_text: 那就是打呼噜。我打呼噜吗？

blocks.en_text: I don't think I do,
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得我不打，

blocks.en_text: but my wife says that I do.
blocks.zh_text: 但我妻子说我打。

blocks.en_text: Oh, so you do snore!
blocks.zh_text: 哦，所以你就是打呼噜！

blocks.en_text: No, I've never heard myself snore!
blocks.zh_text: 不，我从没听到过自己打呼噜！

blocks.en_text: Let's have a look at the language we learned in this conversation.
blocks.zh_text: 我们来看看这次对话里学到的语言。

blocks.en_text: We learnt 'nightmare', which is 'a bad or scary dream'.
blocks.zh_text: 我们学了“nightmare”，意思是“一个不好的或可怕的梦”。

blocks.en_text: We heard 'exhausted' — 'very tired'.
blocks.zh_text: 我们听到了“exhausted”——“非常累”。

blocks.en_text: And we learnt a way to talk about dreams
blocks.zh_text: 我们还学了一种谈论梦的方法，

blocks.en_text: using the past simple and the past continuous.
blocks.zh_text: 就是用过去简单时和过去进行时。

blocks.en_text: For example, you dreamt that you were
blocks.zh_text: 比如，你梦到你在

blocks.en_text: running around trying to find your family and then you found them.
blocks.zh_text: 到处跑着找你的家人，然后你找到了他们。

blocks.en_text: I did.
blocks.zh_text: 是的。

blocks.en_text: Thanks for listening to Real Easy English.  If you liked this, there are lots more
blocks.zh_text: 感谢收听Real Easy English。如果你喜欢这个节目，我们的网站上还有很多

blocks.en_text: programmes to help you with your English  on our website. Like English In A Minute,
blocks.zh_text: 能帮助你学英语的节目。比如English In A Minute，

blocks.en_text: where we explain one language tip in 60  seconds.
blocks.zh_text: 我们在里面用60秒讲解一个语言小贴士。

blocks.en_text: Visit BBC Learning English dot com.
blocks.zh_text: 请访问BBC Learning English点com。

blocks.en_text: Next time, we'll talk about our favourite films.
blocks.zh_text: 下次，我们要聊我们最喜欢的电影。

blocks.en_text: See you then, goodbye!
blocks.zh_text: 到时候见，再见！

blocks.en_text: Bye!
blocks.zh_text: 再见！
